To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) we validated a manual rating approach that is significantly correlated with cognitive engagement, involvement and situational interest as well as performance on a subsequent test and (b) we provided a proof of the concept for a machine learning based analysis that can estimate manual ratings of engagement and that is able to predict posttest variables.
(1) a new manual coding system for engagement can be validated, and (2) machine vision can be used to automatically assess engagement.
a new manual rating system was validated and that a machine vision based automated analysis approach was successfully developed and evaluated on pilot classroom data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an automated analysis of students' visible engagement in learning in the context of classroom instruction and its application in educational practice.
developing a new approach to assess students' visible indicators of engagement and with the application of machine learning methods for automated analyses of classroom videos.
the question of how to improve the assessment of students' engagement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the machine learning approach is a promising tool to support teachers and researchers in analyzing students' engagement.
the machine vision approach is promising and that it is possible to use machine vision to assess visible indicators of (in)attention.
the machine learning approach is a promising tool that can support teacher training and classroom instruction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the manual rating system is valid and the automated analysis provides good estimations of manual ratings and predicts performance.
the machine vision based approach is a promising tool to analyze students' visible engagement in learning activities in classroom settings.
we were able to show that the machine learning based approach can be used to automatically assess students' visible indicators of attention related processes in the classroom.
The main takeaway from our work is that
machine learning can be a valuable tool in analyzing classroom recordings.
machine vision based approaches to the assessment of visible engagement are a promising avenue for the future.
automated approaches have great potential for supporting teachers in their efforts to improve students' learning.
